about: Cost levers (F2c D), read by bin/levers.py. batch_kinds: the job kinds that may wait for a discounted batch answer (never an urgent job). entries: per connection, whether it offers discounted batch processing and its prompt-cache policy (a connection with no row gets default_cache and no batch). fanout: the parallel-reviewer fan-out sends one call, waits for its first token, then sends the rest; the scheduler M1 that will own this wait does not exist yet, so the caller passes the wait as a callback and the code in bin/levers.py is a test double of it. lifetime_gap_percentile: the share of the measured gaps between calls (percent) the chosen lifetime must cover. layout: part order (the first group first), the text between parts, the name prefix of a tool part. lint.volatile_patterns: text that must never stand in a stable part (a timestamp, a run id): a pattern that matches there fails the prefix lint.
